// Harness self-test for the WANT corpus checker. Under the stub scanner — every
// call to flag() is a finding — this file holds one matched annotation, one
// finding with no WANT (UNEXPECTED), and one WANT with no finding (MISSED).
// TestCorpusHarnessReportsBothDirections requires both mismatches reported.
package mismatch

func flag() {}

func probe() int {
	flag() // WANT stub
	flag()
	n := 1 // WANT stub
	return n
}
